name: Productize a freelance service: fixed scope, price, timeline
goal: Turn bespoke freelance work into a productized offer with predetermined deliverable, fixed price, and fixed timeline/scope so sales skip custom scoping and delivery becomes repeatable.

source.title: You Should Productize Your Service - Here Is How To Do It!

prerequisites: A service you have delivered multiple times
constraints: Operational freelancing/product procedure only — no get-rich-quick claims.
Ground every step in YouTube-provided captions; adapt UI labels if the product renamed menus.
Only package repeatable work; exclude open-ended R&D.

steps.action: Define the offer as prepackaged: predetermined cost + predetermined scope + stated result in a stated timebox.
Write inclusions vs exclusions to escape unique-every-time projects that burn you out and cede control to clients.
Publish a fixed price and turnaround so buyers can skip long rate/scope negotiation.
State ideal client and when NOT to buy (heavy custom → separate bespoke engagement).
Standardize intake → produce → QA → handoff checklist/templates for every order.
